# Contributing

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CONTRIBUTING.vi.md)

Open an issue before changing model/runtime invariants. Use focused commits, ideally <=600 changed source lines. Run CPU pytest + Playwright and document TPU impact. Do not commit weights, passwords, tokens, private notebooks or altered acceptance evidence. Preserve bilingual docs and model-license separation.
